Dear Sir/ Madam(s), 
 
Sub: Audio recording of the Earnings Call on Unaudited Financial Results of J. K. 
Cement Limited (“the Company”) for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended on 
September 30, 2026. 
 
In compliance with Regulation 30 and Regulation 46(2)(oa) read with Para A of Part A of 
Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as 
amended from time to time, the audio recording of the Earnings Call held today i.e., Tuesday, 
October 27, 2026 on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the 
Company for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, is now available 
on the website of the Company at: https://www.jkcement.com/transcript-report/
